newsitem.title: USA: CSX acquiring Conrail for $8.4 billion.
newsitem.headline: CSX acquiring Conrail for $8.4 billion.

text.p: CSX Corp. said on Tuesday that it was acquiring Conrail Inc., a rival rail transport company in the eastern United States, for about $8.4 billion in cash and stock.

The combination will create a dominant freight transportation company with annual revenues of more than $14 billion, offering domestic and international customers rail, container-shipping, barge, and intermodal transportation services.

The newly created transportation system will offer extensive rail service in 22 eastern states over 29,645 miles (47,600 km) of track covering a territory from Chicago, Boston and New York to Miami and New Orleans.

The announcement said Conrail shareholders will receive a combination of cash and CSX shares valued at about $92.50 per Conrail share -- a big premium over the stock's closing price of $71 on Monday. CSX shares closed at $49.50 on Monday.

It said total benefits from the combination will be about $550 million annually from cost savings from operating efficiencies, facility consolidations, overhead reductions and other activities, as well as new traffic volumes.
The deal, announced before U.S. stock markets opened, is expected to be completed late next year.
